name: storm_fleet_spy_no_draw_without_your_attack
notes: P3daf587247 G4, the negative twin. Printed: 'Raid - When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, draw a card.' Seat 0 goes to combat and declares no attacker, then casts Storm Fleet Spy in its postcombat main phase: no card is drawn (hand 0). On seat 1's turn, seat 1 attacks seat 0 with a Wolf (seat 0 takes 3), then a second Storm Fleet Spy enters under seat 0's control: the opponent attacked, not you, so seat 0 draws nothing (seat 0's hand stays 0, its library keeps all six cards).
